gen.title: Check core ideas about gas molecules

cards.stem: What does the kinetic theory assume about molecules compared to their spacing?
options: very small relative to the distance between molecules
large enough to fill the container
identical in mass to the container walls
cards.quote: The model, called the kinetic theory of gases, assumes that the molecules are very small relative to the distance between molecules.

cards.stem: How is the density of a gas defined?
options: mass of the molecules divided by the volume
mean kinetic energy of the gas
cards.quote: The density of a gas is simply the sum of the mass of the molecules divided by the volume which the gas occupies.

cards.stem: What physical property does gas pressure measure at the molecular level?
cards.quote: The pressure of a gas is a measure of the linear momentum of the molecules.

cards.stem: What does temperature indicate about gas molecules?
cards.quote: The temperature of a gas is a measure of the mean kinetic energy of the gas.
